items.desc: OttoTHON is a Dance Marathon fundraiser that lasts from 11 AM - 10 PM! All of the funds raised will benefit the children and families at Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital. The day will consist of food, dancing, fundraising, games, a parade to the hospital, guest speakers, interactions with kids from the hospital, and more!
